body.name: public population program \(\mathsf A\)
body.construction: Starting from the observed intervention-label set \(V=[n]\) with \(|V|=t\), inspect \(R(V\setminus\{k\})\) for every remaining label and remove the smallest label \(k\) whose queried matrix has rank \(t-1\). Reverse the removal order to obtain \(\pi\). In decreasing order index and increasing later index, compare \(\|P_{\operatorname{col}}(R(V_t))P_{\operatorname{null}}(R(M_{t,j}))\|_{\mathrm{op}}\), where \(M_{t,j}=V_j\setminus(\{\pi_t\}\cup D_t)\) and \(D_t\) is the descendant-closed set already recorded for \(\pi_t\); add the corresponding arrow between observed intervention labels exactly when the comparison is zero, preserve recorded arrows, and query every singleton \(R_m\) for the row \(m\) of the environment-labelled encoder class.
